fields.name: date
fields.description: Reading date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Past and future dates are both supported, for editorial scheduling and backfill. Defaults to the current day in the timezone parameter.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. It sets how long the day and the night actually are, which is what the dosha periods are cut from.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. It sets the clock time of sunrise at this place.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Selects which day counts as current when date is omitted, and which local day sunrise is computed for. Defaults to UTC, so the reading rolls over at 00:00 UTC. Accepts an IANA name (e.g. "Europe/London"), decimal hours (e.g. 5.5 for IST), or a fixed UTC offset (e.g. "-05:00").
